supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: currencyservice_latency-50 z=403.46 (2017.3%); currencyservice_latency-90 z=156.44 (782.2%); frontend_latency-90 z=156.1 (780.5%); currencyservice_mem z=69.79 (349.0%)
traces for currencyservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.14->0.1ms (0.7x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 5.03->99.13ms (19.71x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: E1 shows memory deviating (z=69.79), but E2 shows currencyservice's own span self-time did not rise (0.14->0.1ms). The slowdown appears only in inbound caller-observed time (5.03->99.13ms, 19.71x). Memory pressure would slow its own processing, so the time is being added on the network path.

frontend latency-90 (z=156.1, E1) is lower than currencyservice latency-50 (z=403.46, E1). E2 shows calls into currencyservice slowing about 20x, which fits frontend being a victim of the slow calls, not the origin.

proposed_fix.description: Check currencyservice's network path (pod network policy, sidecar or traffic-control rules, node NIC) and remove the injected or added latency, e.g. clear tc netem rules on its interface. If the cause is unclear, roll out a restart of the currencyservice pods onto healthy nodes. Then confirm that inbound p50 drops back to about 5ms.
